datasets.name: UAV remote image and digital surface model (DSM) of the upper reach of the Jinsha River

methods.name: AMU-Net (Attention Multiscale U-Net)
methods.summary: A feature enhancement framework that integrates attention and multiscale mechanisms with a U-Net architecture. It uses an attention module in the convolutional block to enhance feature response, a multiscale module in skip connections to capture contextual information, and a shifted window strategy during prediction to enhance the receptive field and reduce boundary errors.
methods.verbatim: Data and code are available at https://github.com/virylon/AMU-Net.

availability.author_statement: Stated as 'No data was used for the research described in the article.'

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not referenced or linked. The custom AMU-Net code is available via a provided GitHub repository link, which contains datasets for reproducibility.
